mentions.name: Hamilton (Health Connect dashboard)
mentions.description: Android app that aggregates all of a user's Health Connect data into one dashboard, unifying metrics from Garmin watches, Withings scales, Samsung Health nutrition tracking, Liftosaur workouts, and other connected health apps. Built largely with AI, it is priced cheaply with no recurring fees.
mentions.problem: Health and fitness data is fragmented across multiple devices and apps (watches, scales, nutrition trackers, workout apps), making it hard to see everything in one place.
mentions.source_excerpt: A vibe-coded app that shows all your Android Health Connect data in one place. I use it daily because I have a garmin watch, withings scale, samsung health for nutrition data, liftosaur for workouts etc.
mentions.author: hamilton_app
